entries.title: q_o preserves the literal action-outcome profile
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) implies the exact set of represented pairs (literal column c, OUTCOME value v) is identical.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Both legality and each literal action outcome are invariant under QO_EQ.

entries.title: q_r preserves the action-outcome profile under transport
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) preserves the represented action/outcome profile after applying the identity-or-reflection column transporter.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The q_r future equivalence is action-transported and WDL tokens are unchanged.

entries.title: a represented nonterminal value has a value-preserving action witness
entries.body: If VALUE(q,v) holds and NO_LEGAL(q) is false, at least one legal column c satisfies OUTCOME(q,c,v).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: This existential witness is a conjunct of both the P0 max and P1 min VALUE clauses.

entries.title: value-preserving literal actions are q_o-invariant
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) preserves exactly the literal columns c for which OUTCOME(q,c,v) equals the node VALUE v.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Node value and literal action outcomes are both QO invariant.

entries.title: value-preserving actions transport across q_r
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) transports the set of exact value-preserving actions by c->c or c->6-c.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Scalar value is constant on the q_r class and the action/outcome profile transports.

entries.title: exact root action witnesses can be reused across q_r with orientation transport
entries.body: An established exact action c satisfying OUTCOME(q,c,VALUE(q)) may be reused for a QR_EQ state only after applying the q_r action transporter.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The transported action preserves its exact outcome/value witness.

entries.title: advisory promotion need not be value-preserving
entries.body: PROMOTE(q,c) does not by itself imply OUTCOME(q,c,VALUE(q)).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: PROMOTE has no primitive VALUE support path; an admissible model may assign the promoted action a nonoptimal represented outcome.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

entries.title: promotion is correctness-neutral only as an advisory hint
entries.body: PROMOTE may influence evaluation order, but it may be used as an exact root action only after a separate value-preserving action witness is established.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Ordering safety is permutation safety, not proof that the promoted action attains the optimum.

entries.title: action-bearing q_r cache is sound with transporter plus value witness
entries.body: A cached literal action under q_r is correctness-safe when the entry also represents that the action attains the cached scalar value and lookup applies the orientation transporter.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Both missing burdens—value preservation and physical-column transport—are discharged.

entries.title: scalar and action payloads have different q_r reuse contracts
entries.body: A q_r cache may reuse scalar WDL unconditionally within the verified class, while any literal action payload carries an additional transporter/value-witness obligation.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Scalar invariance is stronger than literal-coordinate invariance.

entries.title: reflection-fixed q has a reflection-symmetric action-outcome profile
entries.body: If REFLECT_Q(q,rq) and QO_EQ(q,rq), then OUTCOME(q,c,v) iff OUTCOME(q,6-c,v).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The reflected state is QO-equivalent to q, so the transported action profile returns to the same q content.

entries.title: reflection-fixed q has mirrored value-preserving actions
entries.body: For a reflection-fixed q with VALUE(q,v), every value-preserving action c has reflected action 6-c also value-preserving.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The action-outcome profile is symmetric at the node value.

entries.title: advisory promotion may break symmetry that exact action values preserve
entries.body: A reflection-fixed q can have a symmetric exact action/outcome profile while PROMOTE selects only one side of an equal-effect pair.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: CENTER_ORDER is an orientation-sensitive tie break layered over reflection-equivariant game/effect structure.

entries.title: q-step target identity is semantic, not raw occurrence identity
entries.body: Q_STEP(q,c,u) and Q_STEP(q,c,v) force QO_EQ(u,v) but do not force raw EQUAL(u,v).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Successor functionality is extensional; the raw object carrier has no extensional-object collapse axiom.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

entries.title: semantic dependency dedup does not collapse execution occurrences
entries.body: Deduplicating q dependencies by QO_EQ or QR_EQ can preserve semantic value work while task occurrences remain separately addressable.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Semantic target multiplicity and execution occurrence multiplicity are distinct layers.

entries.title: every valid residual has at most 625 term members
entries.body: RESIDUAL_VALID(A) can contain no more than the 625 frozen residual terms.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Residual membership ranges over a finite 625-element term carrier.

entries.title: the q_o semantic-content space is finite
entries.body: There are at most 7^7 * 2^625 * 2^625 distinct q_o content classes before applying residual-antichain restrictions.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: A support has seven fields each in seven heights; each residual extension is a subset of the 625-term carrier.

entries.title: the q_r semantic-content space is finite
entries.body: The number of q_r classes is finite and no greater than the number of q_o classes.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: q_r is a quotient of the finite q_o content space.

entries.title: the semantic q dependency DAG is finite and acyclic
entries.body: On semantic q_o or q_r content classes, Q_DEPENDENCY forms a finite rank-stratified DAG.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Finiteness comes from finite content; acyclicity comes from strict rank increase.

entries.title: finite acyclicity does not prove current VALUE totality
entries.body: The current relational theory's finite acyclic semantic dependency structure does not by itself establish that every Q_VALID carrier object has a VALUE witness.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The theory lacks an extensional-comprehension axiom guaranteeing carrier objects for every support/residual/q successor content; well-foundedness cannot create missing relation witnesses.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

entries.title: current totality gap is representational existence, not recursive cycling
entries.body: The identified obstruction to deriving total Q_STEP/VALUE from the present primitive theory is missing carrier-object comprehension for defined extensional outputs, not a cycle in the dependency relation.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Local transformations are functional up to extensional equality and recursion is well-founded, but existence of target carrier witnesses is not universally asserted.

entries.title: extensional comprehension would make guarded primitive transitions total
entries.body: Conditional on an explicit axiom that every valid support/residual/q extensional content has a carrier object, SUPPORT_STEP, BLOCK_TRANSITION, guarded OWN_TRANSITION and non-immediate Q_STEP each have a target witness.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Each definition uniquely determines valid extensional target content; comprehension supplies a carrier for that content.
side_conditions: explicit extensional-comprehension premise is conditional and not asserted true by current theory

entries.title: extensional comprehension would make every legal non-immediate action have a q successor
entries.body: Under the comprehension condition of IA-I202, LEGAL(q,c) and absence of IMMEDIATE imply existence of qp with Q_STEP(q,c,qp).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Landing is unique, mover/block transformations have represented extensional results, and comprehension supplies q target objects.
side_conditions: explicit extensional-comprehension premise is conditional and not asserted true by current theory

entries.title: extensional comprehension would make VALUE total by backward induction
entries.body: Under IA-I202's comprehension condition, every Q_VALID q has exactly one VALUE token.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Induct on 42-rank: no-legal states yield zero; otherwise every legal action has immediate or lower-rank successor outcome, so finite max/min exists and is unique.
side_conditions: explicit extensional-comprehension premise is conditional and not asserted true by current theory

entries.title: VALUE totality remains unadmitted without comprehension
entries.body: Without adding and qualifying the extensional-comprehension premise, the unconditional assertion 'every Q_VALID q has a VALUE' is not admitted by this closure campaign.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The conditional proof identifies the exact missing premise; Core 0.19 forbids importing it silently.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

entries.title: task budget is independent of semantic rank
entries.body: The SPLIT predicate is determined by node-count budget, not q rank; equal-rank tasks can split at different execution times/counts.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Budget comparison lives entirely in task-control state.

entries.title: semantic q_r sharing opportunity can exist across tasks
entries.body: Distinct task occurrences may project to the same q_r class and therefore have a sound scalar VALUE-sharing opportunity.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Occurrence multiplicity and q_r value equivalence can coexist.

entries.title: sound semantic sharing does not imply a performance win
entries.body: The existence of an exact q_r reuse relation is insufficient to conclude that implementing or increasing sharing reduces total cycles or latency.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Publication/probe/coherence/displacement and overlap costs remain outside semantic equivalence.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

entries.title: workload-distribution QU remains load-bearing for sharing economics
entries.body: Any claim about net benefit from cross-task/q_r sharing retains the runtime workload-distribution QU dependency.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The semantic graph supplies correctness, while duplicate frequency, avoided work and sharing cost remain unresolved runtime quantities.

entries.title: semantic closure and performance closure are separate fixed points
entries.body: Reaching an implicit-assertion fixed point for q/value semantics cannot discharge runtime/JIT/work-distribution QU or establish performance optimality.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The semantic and execution-economic dependency graphs have intentionally separate unresolved regions.
entries.NEI_scope: scope stated by assertion; non-entailment where applicable

depth_semantics: longest admitted IA-premise chain from the frozen explicit A0 base; checkpoint round is not assumed equal to derivation depth
